role: real hot-corridor thermal data with ENACT power proxy and CuCD-ID pattern-level attacks
limitations: Kaggle hot-corridor values appear standardized; metrics are reported in dataset units unless inverse scaling metadata is provided. CuCD-ID is spacecraft cybersecurity telemetry and is used only for attack timing labels, not thermal measurements.
cucd_label_policy: Label != 3 mapped to attack timing only
temperature_model: fallback thermal model driven by real BDG2 electricity/weather substitute inputs
